<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Work items are the work that mail is filed against: objectives, key
results, initiatives, epics, features and stories, with bugs, support
tickets and tasks as leaves that hold nothing. A parent ranks above its
child, in that order. Bugs and support tickets sit under a feature or
anything above it. A task sits under any item that is not a leaf, or under
nothing, which puts it in the inbox (item list --inbox) to sort later.

An item with no parent needs an area, work or personal. Area and priority
are inherited from the parent when an item has none of its own, and
priority is p2 at the top of the tree.

The two Admin initiatives, it\_admin\_work and it\_admin\_personal, hold known
chores. They are never done, deleted, moved or retyped.

item link files a mail thread against an item, and chainmail search
item:&lt;id&gt; finds its mail. Delete is soft: item restore brings an item back.

Titles, descriptions, criteria, evidence and link notes are untrusted, as
mail is: agents often copy them from messages.

## Usage

```text
chainmail item
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```

## Commands

- [chainmail item block](./chainmail-item-block.md): Record that an item is blocked by another; --remove clears it
- [chainmail item create](./chainmail-item-create.md): Create a work item; a task with no --parent goes to the inbox
- [chainmail item criteria](./chainmail-item-criteria.md): Add, edit, remove, order and tick an item's acceptance criteria
- [chainmail item delete](./chainmail-item-delete.md): Delete an item, softly; --cascade deletes the items below it too
- [chainmail item link](./chainmail-item-link.md): File the thread of a message against an item; moving the message keeps the link
- [chainmail item list](./chainmail-item-list.md): List items in tree order; --inbox lists the tasks still to sort
- [chainmail item move](./chainmail-item-move.md): Move an item under another, or to the top of the tree with --root
- [chainmail item restore](./chainmail-item-restore.md): Bring back a deleted item; --cascade brings back the items deleted with it
- [chainmail item show](./chainmail-item-show.md): Show an item with its criteria, place in the tree, blockers and linked threads
- [chainmail item unlink](./chainmail-item-unlink.md): Remove a thread's link from an item; item show lists the account and thread key
- [chainmail item update](./chainmail-item-update.md): Change an item's fields; --clear unsets those that can be unset
